items.title: ‘Egglets – The Long 10 Days’ has you managing a crisis
items.zh_title: 《Egglets – The Long 10 Days》让你在危机中当镇长
items.summary: Ever wonder what it would be like to be a mayor of a small town during worldwide, life changing events? In Egglets – The Long 10 Days you will be doing just... The post ‘Egglets – The Long 10 Days’ ha…
items.zh_summary: 有没有想过，在席卷全球的巨变中当一个小镇镇长是什么感觉？在《Egglets – The Long 10 Days》里，你要做的正是这件事。

items.title: Camera 101: How to choose your game’s perspective
items.zh_title: 镜头 101：如何选择游戏的视角
items.summary: A beginner’s guide to video game camera perspectives: top-down, side-scrolling, first-person, third-person, isometric, and fixed views.
items.zh_summary: 一份新手指南，讲游戏镜头视角：俯视、横版卷轴、第一人称、第三人称、等距和固定视角。

items.title: How Soft Crunch Games built Foxy Dumplings for every platform
items.zh_title: Soft Crunch Games 如何用一个项目把《Foxy Dumplings》带到全平台
items.summary: See how the team behind Foxy Dumplings built one Unity project for PC, console, and mobile, covering platform abstraction, input, profiling, and Cloud Save.
items.zh_summary: 看看《Foxy Dumplings》团队如何用一个 Unity 项目覆盖 PC、主机和移动端，内容涵盖平台抽象、输入、性能分析和云存档。
